summary: Frontend-only verification of CHECK #3 (Smart Import 'Create + Facebook') and CHECK #4 (PostNowDialog 'Facebook' share) in Organisation Dashboard. Both flows PASS: FB sharer URL points at the event-specific /api/events/{id}/og?bn_card=2 rich URL and a Blackrod Now-branded caption is copied to the clipboard with the expected toast.
critical_code_review_comments: OrgDashboard.jsx has grown to 2163 lines and contains multiple concerns (parsing UI, dialogs, publish flow, share pack card). Consider splitting the ParsedCard, SharePackCard, and publish/share logic into dedicated modules for maintainability.

ShareButtons.facebook.onClick tries clipboard.writeText but silently swallows the error — if Permissions API denies clipboard, users still see 'Blackrod Now caption copied' toast even though nothing was copied. Consider toasting a fallback message on catch.
test_credentials: Org shared password TestOrgPass123! (used with POST /api/organisations/blackrod-town-council/auth/login) — worked without needing an admin reset.
